items.headline: Could NY finally pass a single-payer healthcare system?
items.excerpt: After decades of failed attempts to establish a single-payer healthcare system in the Empire State, supporters of the New York Health Act are anticipating renewed momentum after Democrats clinched a supermajority in both chambers of the State Legislature.

items.headline: Firefighters remember beloved Harmony Corners Fire captain
items.excerpt: After Harmony Corners Fire Captain and Saratoga County Correction Officer Jason Hewitt suddenly died this past weekend, his fellow firefighters have been sharing his profound impact on the community.

items.headline: BOCES students cook up 2,000 Thanksgiving meals
